title: BPSSC Bihar Police ASI Technical Recruitment 2026 Online Form Live: 22 Posts Apply Now #BPSSCASI Technical2026 #BiharPoliceASI #BPSSCAdvt072026 #BiharPoliceWireless #SarkariNaukri
intro: Bihar Police Sub-Ordinate Service Commission BPSSC  has Released Official Notification for the Post of Assistant Sub-Inspector ASI (Technical) in Bihar Police Radio (Wireless), Govt. of Bihar. Recruitment 2026 for 22 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to this Jobs.Online Apply Start On May 21, 2026 & Last Date is June 21, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in The Given Link Below.
importantDates: Payment Mode: Pay Exam Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode.
Lat Date For Fee Payment: 21 June 2026
Candidates must have passed a 3-Year Diploma Course from a State Government / Central Government recognized Polytechnic Institute as on 01.08.2025.
Minimum 50% Marks are required in Diploma Course.
SC / ST Candidates must have minimum 45% Marks.

Diploma must be in any one of the following subjects:
																
																	Electronics & Communication Engineering
																	Electronics & Tele Communication Engineering
																	Information Technology (IT)
																	Electrical & Electronics Engineering
For More Details, Read the Official Notification.
Maximum Age : 37 Years.( General/ EWS Male)
Maximum Age : 40 Years.( BC/ EBC Male & Female)
Maximum Age : 42 Years. (SC / ST Male & Female)
Age Relaxation Extra as Per Rules.
Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Pre Exam, Mains Exam, PET/ PET & Merit List.
Address (According to Aadhar/ Voter ID/ Driving License/ Passport/ Ration Card/ Birth Certificate ).
Scan Recent Passport Size Photo in JPEG/ PNG Format.
Scan Signature in Hindi & English.. Both Signature Will be on White Paper with Black Ink in JPEG/ PNG Format.

The selection process will consist of:
                    
                        Written Examination
                        Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST)
Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST)

The written examination will be conducted in two stages:
                    
                        Preliminary Examination
                        Main Examination
All questions in written examination will be Objective Type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ).
Negative Marking: 0.2 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.

Paper-I : General Hindi
                    
                        Total Marks: 100 Marks
                        Total Questions: 100 Questions
                        Exam Duration: 2 Hours
                        Minimum Qualifying Marks: 30 Marks
                        Questions will be based on Hindi Language Knowledge.
Questions will be based on Hindi Language Knowledge.

Paper-II : Technical Subject
                    
                        Total Marks: 100 Marks
                        Total Questions: 100 Questions
                        Exam Duration: 2 Hours
                        Question Type: Objective MCQ
                        Exam Level: Polytechnic Diploma Level
The Physical Test will be qualifying in nature.
No marks will be awarded for PET/PST.
Candidates must separately qualify all physical tests.
Final Merit List will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the Main Examination.
Only candidates qualifying PET/PST will be considered for final selection.
21 June 2026: Last date for registration & fee
To Be Notified: Exam Date, Admit Card, Result

3-Year Diploma in Electronics & Communication / Electronics & Tele Communication / Information Technology / Electrical & Electronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks (45% for SC/ST)
Total Vacancy: 22 Posts (Assistant Sub-Inspector Technical - Bihar Police Radio)
Selection Process: Pre Exam + Mains Exam + PET/PST + Merit List
